scope: Installation and commissioning of one explicitly selected sludge-dewatering package SD-MDSP-2X10-D20 using two MDSP-10M3H multi-disc screw presses, 10 m3/h sludge feed, 2 percent inlet dry solids, 20 percent cake dry solids and 8 operating hours per day. Direct feed, polymer, flocculation, conveyance, filtrate, piping, controls, civil, consumable, labor, mechanism, QA and logistics inputs are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater-process designer, screw-press package supplier, polymer-system supplier, equipment manufacturers, commissioning laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: complete wastewater treatment plant, aeration tanks, sludge digestion, drying beds, incineration or external networks
equipment, civil, consumable, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from feed flow, solids percentages or operating hours
automatic odor control, cake storage or standby power
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
